control.source_identity_limitation: The control was rebuilt from root commit 9d6d975 while the candidate was based on 91d87be. The intervening commits 8c38d72 and 9d6d975 change direct-repair tests and C API integer selector validation, not LeopardFF16.cpp or an ISA backend. This makes the screen strong directional kill evidence, but not strict identical-source promotion evidence.

kill_rationale: The candidate saved only 1.56% in one target and was neutral in the other, far below the required credible 5% improvement. Its four additional operation-table members and approximately 7 KiB archive growth are not justified. All production and test changes were reverted; only this negative checkpoint is retained.
